primary_evidence.document: TO-3 edition 1-65, section 3.7, sheet 37; PDF page 20

boundaries: Three cycles start at logical command selection with a ready buffer, not at late RPK.
One and a half cycles start at explicit release of the selected buffer-wait phase.
Unselected readiness is remembered; later selection starts the ready-buffer phase.
Logical PVR/SPOP dependencies use existing ArithmeticUnitStages; no electrical pulse reconstruction claimed.
Operand is sampled at PVR inside the unit pipeline; CPU still evaluates its own operand at instruction completion.
This is the read-from-buffer transfer path, not timing for immediate/index/write operations.
RPK/IZOP generation, automatic opcode decode, memory/device stages and full hardware profile remain incomplete.
